who: Keeps sheep on a hill farm and sits on the village council, where the bus is the only topic.

moments.plot: The county decides about the bus next week. The tups are out and the shed has no door.

tasks.title: Count who gets on at the bridge
tasks.notes: Three mornings. Elin does the school run, so she has the other two.

tasks.title: Collect the petition from the shop
tasks.notes: It was four pages on {weekday-2}. Take a new pen.

tasks.title: Read the county’s new timetable
tasks.notes: They moved the last bus to 16:10. The clinic closes at five.

tasks.title: Ask the driver about the winter route

capture.title: Tell Elin the hall is booked

file.title: How did the next valley keep theirs?
file.notes: Rhodri’s cousin was on that council. Ring after seven.

dated.title: Speak at the county meeting
dated.notes: Leave at eight. The road is slow behind the timber lorry.

repeating.title: Check the top fence
repeating.notes: The corner by the larch. They know about it.

attachments.notes: Open with the clinic. Elin’s numbers in the middle. Finish before they look at the clock.

tasks.title: Guests leave at ten, then sheets
Good coat out of the wardrobe

agent.title: Put the passenger counts in one table
agent.notes: Photos of three notebooks, two handwritings, one wet.
agent.question: How should I group them?
bodies: Over three mornings 112 people got on. The bridge had 47, the school 38 and the shop 27. Two lines in the wet notebook are missing.
Over three mornings 112 people got on. School was 51, the clinic 29, work 24, and 8 did not say.
agent.otherBody: Over three mornings 112 people got on at three stops. Your direction: {answer}
agent.acceptance: The numbers are ready for the county.

discuss.title: Write to the county about the last bus
discuss.notes: 16:10 is no use to anyone with a job or an appointment.
discuss.question: What should the letter ask for?
options: A year to prove the numbers
bodies: A last bus at 16:10 leaves before the clinic closes. We ask you to run it at 17:30, when people can use it.
We counted 112 passengers in three mornings. We ask for one more year on the old timetable, and we will send you the numbers each month.
discuss.otherBody: The last bus at 16:10 leaves before the clinic closes. We ask for this: {answer}
discuss.handoff: Your next step: sign and send it

review.title: Put the passenger counts in one table
review.note: 112 people. Two wet lines I could not read, so I left them out.

review.title: Update the flock list
review.note: Forty-six ewes. Tag 0312 is on it twice.

faded: Ask about the stone wall grant
